description_en: Modifies the authentication configuration of an RDS AI application instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS AI应用实例认证信息配置
kebab_example: aliyun rdsai modify-instance-auth-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-name ra-supabase-8moov5lxba0000 --config-list Value=http://8.152._XXX.XXX Name=GOTRUE_SITE_URL --branch-name example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceAuthConfig

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the AI application
parameters.name: instance_name

fields.help_en:
The configuration item name. Valid values:

GOTRUE_EXTERNAL_EMAIL_ENABLED: specifies whether to allow external email addresses.
GOTRUE_SITE_URL: the website URL displayed when the AI application sends emails.
GOTRUE_SMTP_PORT: the port of the SMTP provider.
GOTRUE_SMTP_SENDER_NAME: the name of the email sender.
GOTRUE_SMTP_USER: the username of the SMTP provider.
GOTRUE_SMTP_PASS: the secret key of the SMTP provider.
GOTRUE_SMTP_ADMIN_EMAIL: the email address of the SMTP provider.
GOTRUE_SMTP_HOST: the host address of the SMTP provider.
GOTRUE_MAILER_AUTOCONFIRM: specifies whether to enable automatic confirmation.
GOTRUE_MAILER_OTP_EXP: the validity period of the one-time password (OTP). Unit: seconds.
GOTRUE_MAILER_OTP_LENGTH: the length of the one-time password (OTP) verification code. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to 6
fields.help_zh:
配置项名称。 取值：

GOTRUE_EXTERNAL_EMAIL_ENABLED：允许外部邮箱。
GOTRUE_SITE_URL：AI应用发送邮件时显示的网站URL。
GOTRUE_SMTP_PORT：SMTP服务商的端口。
GOTRUE_SMTP_SENDER_NAME：邮件发送者的名称。
GOTRUE_SMTP_USER：SMTP服务商的用户名。
GOTRUE_SMTP_PASS：SMTP服务商的密钥。
GOTRUE_SMTP_ADMIN_EMAIL：SMTP服务商的邮件地址。
GOTRUE_SMTP_HOST：SMTP服务商的主机地址（Host）。
GOTRUE_MAILER_AUTOCONFIRM：是否开启自动确认。
GOTRUE_MAILER_OTP_EXP：一次性密码（OTP）的有效期限。单位为秒。
GOTRUE_MAILER_OTP_LENGTH：一次性密码（OTP）的验证码长度。取值为大于等于6的整数
